title: [NSW] Free Public EV Charging (Parking Fee Applies before 6pm) @ Dutton Plaza Carpark, Cabramatta
body:
Deal: [NSW] Free Public EV Charging (Parking Fee Applies before 6pm) @ Dutton Plaza Carpark, Cabramatta

[MrZ] I don't think even people in Sydney know where Cabramatta is.
[Satchimo] I don't know, it is home to the annual Cabramatta Moon Festival each September.
[killingtime] Do you know where Springvale or Gosnells is?
[MrZ] If we're going by distance from CBD, a fair comparison would be Hampton Park or Melton.
[MrKnowItAll] As a Gosnells resident, I’ve spent years trying to forget where Gosnells is.
[Satchimo] Is there a park with a free public BBQ nearby?
[CptnObvious] With V2L you can bbq from your vehicle, in the parking lot.
[Eleven55] I'm sure with Vehicle to Load, you can connect an induction stove somewhere.
[cerealsmok3r] I would avoid unless youre in the area. There's always cars lined up for it so pretty rare to get a spot
[cerealsmok3r] I'd recommend just getting in after 6:00pm. there's a handful of peeps that will quickly snatch that up. otherwise 9-10pm usually has a spot or two free if you want to grab some snacks
[Munki] Mate we don't need more people here queuing up for the chargers. There's only like 4 of them anyway.
[stirlo] There’s free 7-22kw chargers all over the place. Just look on plug share. No deal
[killingtime] Exactly, If we individually listed every single free charger as a bargain here, there would be hundreds, if not thousands of them.
Many of them are even actually free all the time, not just after 6 p.m. until the close of the car park.
[alitadark] This one has been here for years but the likelihood of actually getting one of the 4 is slim to none.
[edfoo] LOL now you have published this, the site will be hogged by those selfish inconsiderate EV owners all night long. Good luck trying to get a charging spot now.
[Satchimo] now…the site will be hogged by those selfish inconsiderate EV owners all night long.
As opposed to the non selfish owners "trying to get a charging spot, now."?
[paloverde88] 7kw means you need to watch 3 movies at hoyts back to back before its up to 75% full
[GregFiona] what’s wrong with watching the movies in the car?
[Peekay] Surely this isn't worth posting as a deal?
Free chargers are still dotted all over the place. If we posted all of them on ozb the whole page would be filled with them.
[Satchimo] if we posted all of them on ozb the whole page would be filled with them.
In that case, somebody should double dip and develop a vibe coded app about them.
[Satchimo] Has anybody posted that on OzBargain yet seeking free market research, data collection, bug detection and suggestions for improvement?
[OZKap] @Satchimo: of course they have https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/970486
[Satchimo] @OZKap: Plugroo. And I think it is a website, isn't it?
But LMAO at it providing details to somebody's private charger in their private residential property! .
[ruprectaus] Is that JV in the photo trying to pay for his petrol ?
[OZKap] Why not support our very own vibe-coded slop website, Plugaroo?
[Matt P] Anyone who camps out a free charger is a false economist.
People on $50-70 an hour with their FBT exempt novated lease trying to save $18 charging it at home and losing an hour/2 of their life.
Spot one opportunistically? Sure, plug in. Go out of your way? Wasting your time.
[LINK91] Right, but time is money lol. Unless you are already there for a purpose, going to these and waiting ~2 hours for 30% as that only costs like 5 bucks on chargefox(model 3) absolutely defeats the purpose.
[nullpointerm] Not worth it. Have been here a couple times now. All the chargers are always taken and there is a line of cars waiting each time. Sames as Rhodes.
